mcqs.question: The SCO Summit 2025 Tianjin Declaration was adopted on which date and at which place?
mcqs.explanation: The SCO Summit 2025 Tianjin Declaration was adopted on 1 September 2025 in Tianjin, China, by the 10-member SCO. The tempting alternative of 31 August 2025 refers to the date of the Modi–Xi meeting, not the adoption of the Declaration.
